title: Tessera: Structure-Completed Evidence Units for Web Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits a page into fixed-size text chunks or, in recent visual pipelines, screenshot tiles, and the retrieved item serves at once as the unit of indexing, ranking, and reading. We trace answer evidence from source HTML to reader input over the full English Wikipedia and find that this coupling loses evidence in text and screenshot pipelines alike: evidence present in the source page often fails to reach the reader intact, particularly structured content such as tables and infoboxes, which chunking separates from the headers and context that give it meaning. Stronger extraction, context expansion, and larger reader budgets leave the loss in place. We present Tessera, a training-free evidence delivery layer that decouples what a pipeline retrieves from what its reader reads. translated_title: Tessera：面向网页检索增强生成的结构补全证据单元
translated_abstract: 网页检索增强生成（RAG）将页面切分为固定大小的文本块，或在近期的视觉流水线中切分为截图瓦片，检索到的条目同时充当索引、排序和阅读的单元。我们在完整的英文维基百科上追踪答案证据从源HTML到阅读器输入的全过程，发现这种耦合在文本和截图两类流水线中都会丢失证据：源页面中存在的证据往往无法完整送达阅读器，尤其是表格和信息框这类结构化内容，因为分块处理将其与赋予其意义的标题和上下文分离了。更强的抽取方法、上下文扩展以及更大的阅读器预算都无法消除这种损失。我们提出Tessera，一个无需训练的证据传递层，它将流水线检索的内容与阅读器读取的内容解耦。给定任何排序列表背后的页面，Tessera会将其HTML重建为细粒度的证据单元，每个单元都补全了其……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出无需训练的证据传递层Tessera，通过将网页HTML重建为结构补全的细粒度证据单元并解耦检索与阅读，解决了表格、信息框等结构化内容在RAG流水线中因分块而丢失证据的问题。
en_tdlr: Tessera is a training-free evidence delivery layer that rebuilds retrieved pages' HTML into fine-grained, structure-completed evidence units, decoupling retrieval from reading to preserve structured content such as tables and infoboxes that chunking-based RAG pipelines lose.
